headline: Why a Top AI Founder Is Ditching 'AGI' for 'World Models'
reasoning: This topic scores high on clickability and format diversity. It features a prominent AI figure taking a contrarian stance against popular buzzwords like 'AGI', which is great for sparking debate. The concept of 'world models' is a fresh and easily explainable angle on the future of AI, lending itself perfectly to explainers, comparisons, and hot-take articles.
summary: The CEO of AMI Labs, a well-funded AI startup co-founded by Yann LeCun, is dismissing terms like 'AGI' and 'superintelligence' as useless. Instead, the company is focused on building 'world models,' a type of AI designed to understand physics and the real world to power the next generation of robotics.

source_articles.title: Why AMI Labs’ Alexandre LeBrun won’t call his AI ‘AGI’ or ‘superintelligence’
source_articles.excerpt: While everyone in AI is chasing "superintelligence," Alexandre LeBrun, CEO of Yann LeCun’s world model startup, AMI Labs, dismisses the word.
